media:group.media:title: Arte in Pista — Vallelunga Circuit
media:group.media:description:
Under the Lazio sky and set against the backdrop of the Eternal City, the Vallelunga hills hosted two days of speed, passion, and shared moments.
Arte in Pista arrived at Autodromo Vallelunga for the fourth chapter of our 2026 season. Where every moment celebrated the harmony between art and science. Guided by dedicated engineers and coaches, our drivers pushed the performance limits of both the Huayra R and Huayra R Evo Roadster, turning every lap into a display of pure emotion. Thank you to our drivers, technical team, and guests for making Vallelunga an unforgettable experience. See you in the next chapter.
#Pagani #PaganiAutomobili #ArteInPista2026

entry.title: Arte in Pista — Circuit Paul Ricard 2026

media:group.media:title: Arte in Pista — Circuit Paul Ricard 2026
media:group.media:description: What happens when pure engineering turns into human emotion? The second round of Arte in Pista 2026 at Circuit Paul Ricard was not simply a track event but a true tribute to the Pagani philosophy, showing what happens when technical perfection serves a deep and shared passion. Over the course of two days in Le Castellet, the track became a sanctuary of performance. Under the guidance of our dedicated coaches and engineers, our drivers have immersed themselves in a motorsport ecosystem tailor-made for them. On the track, the Huayra R and Huayra R Evo Roadster went wild, challenging the Provence wind. Once again, Arte in Pista represented a free space where boundaries are pushed not toward competition, but toward personal fulfillment. Thanks to our amazing community for reminding us what drives us every day. #Pagani #PaganiAutomobili #ArteInPista2026

media:group.media:title: Pagani Utopia Roadster
media:group.media:description:
What if lightness held the secret formula of performance? Inside the Utopia Roadster, more than forty advanced composite formulas — including Carbo-Titanium HP62-G2 and Carbo-Triax HP62 — come together to create a structure engineered for maximum efficiency and driving sensation.
Weighing just 1,280 kg, the Roadster inherits the soul of the Coupé and elevates it even further, delivering a driving experience that is free, fluid, and remarkably light.
#Pagani #PaganiAutomobili #UtopiaRoadster
